t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are eight different gnomes. Some gnomes (e.g., red/purple/pink) pick the red basket, and the other gnomes (e.g., yellow/green/blue) pick the yellow basket. Pick a gnome to get a specific colour basket and if it is generating large numbers of mushrooms, stick with it. If the number of mushrooms steadily decreases, choose the other colour gnomes that pick the other basket.

vb_textbox.text: There are eight different coloured gnomes (pink, red, purple, brown, yellow, green, blue, orange). The pink, red, purple, and brown gnomes always pick the red coloured basket. The yellow, green, blue, and orange gnomes always pick the yellow coloured basket. To start, pick any gnome. If the reward is high in terms of the number of mushrooms picked, stick with the coloured gnomes that give you that specific basket associated with the higher reward. As the rewards start to decrease, select the gnomes to give you the other colour basket. For instance, if you pick a gnome that gives you a red basket, and this gives you lots of mushrooms, continue selecting gnomes associated with the red basket. As the reward decreases, select the gnomes associated with the yellow basket and see if the reward improves. Keep doing this throughout the game. There may be periods associated with higher rewards and others with lower rewards, no matter what basket you choose.
